scripts.dev:prod: concurrently -k -n server,robots,web -c green,gray,blue "npm:server:watch -w backend" "npm:robots -w backend" "npm:dev -w frontend"
scripts.start: npm run build && STATIC_DIR=../frontend/dist npm run server -w backend
scripts.start:demo: npm run build && STATIC_DIR=frontend/dist tsx backend/src/demo/simulator.ts
scripts.test: npm test -w shared && npm test -w frontend && npm test -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend && tsc -p shared --noEmit && tsc -p e2e
